The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride

Omaha, NE · Road

The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride is a road group ride in Omaha, NE. It rolls every Monday at 6:15 pm from The Bike Way. Pace: 20+ mph with regroups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 20+ mph with regroups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride group ride

The weekly road ride of Omaha's race club, run out of The Bike Way. Fast, 20 mph and up, with regroups; riders are expected to know the route and get themselves home. No TT bikes. There is also a Saturday 9 am no-drop ride from Roast Coffeehouse in Aksarben, May through September.
